suites.name: preparation_lifetime
suites.coverage: Captured reader release; preparation pre/post/final wall and CPU refusals; retained identity/hash/link/writer/CAS checks; original runtime and cleanup clocks; resource restoration.
suites.seams: Synthetic clocks and callback fixtures plus short real elapsed-wall controls; no native or user-effect evidence.

suites.name: exact_source_and_diagnostics
suites.coverage: Exact fresh S10 scope and negative substitutions; optional-output behavior; immutable predecessor; first send/observe diagnostic before cleanup; separate cleanup failure; no overwrite or diagnostic-induced cleanup suppression.
suites.seams: Offline source controls; explicit legacy validator seam; no actual mutable history qualification.

suites.name: boundary_consumers
suites.coverage: Typed source/qualification/priority joins; freshness; immutable predecessor closure; unchanged consumed ancestry; producer-to-consumer schemas.
suites.seams: Explicit offline legacy-loader seams; no actual current qualification or canonical-store read.

suites.name: canonical_consumer
suites.coverage: Once-only admission and replay refusals; wrong/late reply refusal; ungraded text; receipt and terminal joins; separate semantic decision; empty-outcome refusal.
suites.seams: Actual source consumers with synthetic semantic and no-wire seams; no live graph, model, native, Telegram or product acceptance.

suites.name: pure_source_binder
suites.coverage: Final source identity; missing capability/hash/symlink/output-boundary rejection; no overwrite; source binding cannot mint current or admission authority.
suites.seams: Owned temporary offline source bindings only; fixtures removed.
